label: Slack: Find Channel
description: Resolves a Slack channel name (with or without #) to its id, among the public and private channels the app can see. Fails loudly when nothing matches or the workspace has over 10000 channels (paste the id then).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs channels:read (groups:read to also see private channels the app is in).

outputs.name: private
outputs.description: Whether the matched channel is private.
